workExperienceSection.workDescription:
• Moved the watch history service from one PostgreSQL primary to 12 shards, which now handles 360,000 requests a minute at under 20 ms
• Found the slowest queries with k6 load tests and added a Redis cache in front of them, raising throughput by **7x**
• Cut the nightly billing export from 6 hours to 40 minutes by batching writes and adding the indexes it was missing
• Mentor two new engineers through their first on-call rotation

• Built the API behind course quizzes in Go, serving 4 million learners a month with a 99.98% success rate
• Led the move from server-rendered pages to Next.js for the course catalog, bringing its Lighthouse score from 62 to 98
• Wrote the team's guide to designing APIs, which three other teams now follow

• Added compression and lazy loading to the ads dashboard, cutting its load time in half for 20,000 advertisers
• Wrote end-to-end tests for the campaign editor that caught three bugs before launch

projectsSection.projectDescription:
• A ratings and reviews service for small online shops, with search by keyword and sorting by helpfulness, date or stars
• Used by 40 shops, handling 2,000 reviews a week on a single small server
• A command-line tool that spins up a throwaway copy of a web app's database and servers on AWS for each test run
